prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `divisors`, `sum_proper_divisors` and `is_perfect` in src/lib.rs. `divisors(n)` returns all positive divisors in ascending order; `divisors(0)` is empty. `sum_proper_divisors(n)` sums divisors strictly less than `n`, and `sum_proper_divisors(0)` is 0. `is_perfect(n)` is true exactly when `n > 1` and its proper divisors sum to `n`.
